purpose: Prevent accidental exposure of Starlette surfaces implicated in legacy 0.49.3 advisories.
audit_expectation: Zero known vulnerabilities; exceptions and ignored advisories are not permitted for v0.3.
rules: No vulnerability exception or ignored advisory is granted for Starlette.
The hash lock must resolve Starlette 1.3.1 or a separately reviewed later version.
Adding file serving, multipart forms, uploads, or HTTPEndpoint requires a new threat review and regression tests.
TrustedHostMiddleware remains mandatory even when nginx is the sole ingress.
